description: Bunker fuel prices (USD per metric ton) from the public Ship & Bunker prices page: VLSFO, IFO380 (HSFO) and MGO price with daily change, for the global and regional averages and major ports (Singapore, Rotterdam, Houston, Fujairah, LA / Long Beach, Hong Kong, New York, Santos). Indicative public assessments, not a firm offer; ex-wharf prices exclude freight and taxes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
